about: Things a screen needed that AD Design Kit cannot express yet. The compose skill adds a row for every gap it finds and marks the stand-in in code with `// ad-design-kit-gap: <id>`. Storybook → Guides → Figma sync lists the rows and where each stand-in is used. Status: open (waiting for Figma) · in-figma (designed, not synced to code yet) · done (synced; remove the stand-in markers, keep the row as history).

gaps.title: Tinted summary band (description list)
gaps.reference: damia-case-study (bbyGbZ3b8P2uT84Pul9qu7): the light-blue "Source Guide" band in the open Sources panel, node 10:672. Earlier seen in Material - powerplay (VH1RUJ8Q0lqiNRfPgIAxRA) 27:17108 and Material Management (Copy) (8gQnE0UCLGaNL5bBMiGERT) 2021:58722.
gaps.need: Key facts or a summary (label/value pairs, or a summary next to key-topic chips) on a light brand-tinted band.
gaps.proposal: Figma component "Description list": Style = Plain | Tinted (bg-brand-softer), Columns = 2 | 3 | 4; item = label (text-xs text-body) over value (text-sm font-medium text-heading).
gaps.standIn: Accordion "Source Guide" holding the same summary and topics, no tint (src/features/damia/SourcesPanel.tsx).

gaps.title: Action tile (large icon + label tile button)

gaps.proposal: Figma component "Action tile": Style = Tinted (bg-brand-softer) | Neutral, Layout = Icon start | Icon top, Size = base | lg, States = Initial, Hover, Focus, Disabled, Busy (spinner).
